subject: SOC2: evidence request — data erasure / retention controls (BankCorp)
messages:
From: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@bankcorp.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: security@bankcorp.com
Date: Tue, 5 Nov 2025 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: SOC2 evidence request — retention & deletion controls

Hi Laura,

We're starting the data residency & retention scope for our SOC2 review and need a set of artifacts showing how Redwood handles retention, deletion, and proof-of-deletion for EU-resident workloads. Specifically, could you provide:

- Retention policy docs that map retention periods by data class (PII, logs, backups).
- Evidence of automated deletion runs (logs/artifacts) for scheduled erasure jobs over the last 12 months.
- Sample proof of deletion for customer datasets (anonymized is fine) showing before/after object counts and timestamps.
- Details on key management and whether key rotation affects ability to recover deleted data.

Target deadline for our auditor is next Friday (2025-11-14). Please let me know timeline and if you need a narrower scope.

Thanks — Olivia
Olivia Turner
Senior InfoSec Manager, BankCorp

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@bankcorp.com>
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 5 Nov 2025 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence request — retention & deletion controls

Hi Olivia,

Thanks for the clear list — we can assemble that. Quick notes and proposed cadence:

- Retention policy: we will attach our current retention matrix and a summarized policy PDF.
- Deletion runs: we can pull automated job logs for the last 12 months and produce anonymized before/after counts.
- Proofs: we will generate a sampled proof artifact for your dataset class (we assume you want deleted message blobs + KV cache entries); confirm if object-level logs are sufficient.
- KMS/key rotation: we will include a short write-up and rotation audit. Rotation does not cause silent recoverability loss — we will explain processes.

Can we deliver everything by EOD Wednesday (2025-11-12)? If Marco from your audit shop needs direct access to artifacts, we can share a constrained Drive folder.

Tagging Hannah and Karthik for the artifacts — Hannah, can your team pull the deletion job logs and sample proofs? Karthik, please add the KMS rotation audit and the retention matrix export.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Product Security, Redwood Inference

From: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 6 Nov 2025 08:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence request — retention & deletion controls

Laura — taking this on. Plan:

1) Export retention_matrix_2025-10.csv with columns (data_class, retention_days, storage_tier, EU_residency_flag, purge_job_name).
2) Pull deletion_job_run_ logs for the last 12 months; redact tenant identifiers and prepare sample_deletion_proof_bankcorp_dataset.txt with before/after object counts & timestamps.
3) Collate the run IDs and job configs (cron schedule + job version).

I'll attach draft artifacts to the response to Olivia once reviewed. If BankCorp needs a narrower artifact set (e.g., only backups vs. primary objects), let us know.

— Hannah
Engineering Manager, Data Ops

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence request — retention & deletion controls

Hi Olivia / Marco — attached are the artifacts we discussed: redwood_retention_policy_v2.pdf, retention_matrix_2025-10.csv, and deletion_job_run_20250930.log. We also included a sample anonymized proof (sample_deletion_proof_bankcorp_dataset.txt).

Highlights:
- Policy maps data classes to retention windows and shows EU residency flag.
- Deletion job logs include job run IDs and before/after object counts. We redacted tenant IDs and replaced them with stable pseudonyms per our redaction policy.
- Sample proof shows timestamps (UTC) and the final object count delta.

Two clarifications we requested earlier:
- Please confirm whether you need object-level hashes or dataflow-level evidence (e.g., message ids vs. table row counts).
- If your auditor needs access to raw logs, we can grant limited Drive access and an expiration.

If the artifacts look good, we'll add a short KMS rotation audit doc (kms_rotation_audit_202504.pdf) in a follow-up this afternoon.

Regards,
Laura

From: Marco Rossi <m.rossi@auditsolutions.io>

Date: Thu, 13 Nov 2025 07:41:00 -0800

Thanks Laura — artifacts received and initial review looks promising. A couple of follow-ups from the auditor:

- Can you provide a short artifact showing a sample "proof of deletion" tied to a real purge job run ID (we need to see request ID -> job run -> deletion confirmation). The sample_deletion_proof file is close but needs the trace to the job run ID.
- We also need confirmation that KMS key rotation cannot be used to retain access to deleted data (i.e., rotation policy and an audit trail).

If you can append those two items we'll be in good shape for the control. Ideally we get that before Monday so we can finalize testing.

Best,
Marco Rossi
Lead Auditor, AuditSolutions
